workarounds.symptom: Enable mac clipboard via pngpaste (Support unseekable attachments)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Support pipe paths for CLI attachments. Target files: llm/cli.py, tests/test_attachments.py. Attachments passed through Bash process substitution, such as `llm "Describe this image" -a <(cat image.png)`, could not be detected because MIME probing expects a seekable file. With an explicit `--at` type, hashing and subsequent reads could instead consume the pipe and lose its content. (Ref: https://github.com/simonw/llm/pull/1857)

workarounds.symptom: `--no-stream` crashes with AttributeError when an OpenAI-compatible endpoint omits `usage`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix crash when a non-streaming Chat Completions response has no usage. Target files: llm/default_plugins/openai_models.py, tests/test_cli_openai_models.py. `Chat.execute()` and `AsyncChat.execute()` called `completion.usage.model_dump()` without checking that `usage` is set. OpenAI-compatible servers can omit the `usage` key or send `"usage": null`, and every `--no-stream` prompt against them failed with `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'model_dump'`. (Ref: https://github.com/simonw/llm/pull/1698)

workarounds.symptom: Collection.embed_multi silently accepts an incorrect number of embeddings
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Raise ValueError when a model returns the wrong number of embeddings. Target files: llm/embeddings.py, tests/test_embed.py. `Collection.embed_multi_with_metadata()` combined model output with the filtered input batch using `zip()`, so a plugin returning fewer embeddings silently omitted entries, and extra embeddings were silently discarded. This validates the counts before writing the current batch and raises `ValueError("Expected N embeddings, got M")` on mismatch. Previously completed batches stay committed, matching the existi... (Ref: https://github.com/simonw/llm/pull/1726)
